chat.readOnly: Your role may read along, but not write.
mobile.aufraeumenHinweis: Filler words out, corrections applied, punctuation set
mobile.aufraeumenNicht: Needs a model credential for your organisation
mobile.desktopHinweis: Open covey in the browser, go to Profile & Settings → Mobile app → “Pair the mobile app”, and click “Open in the app”.
mobile.diagnoseHinweis: The log stays on this device. It records what happens, timings and errors — no content: no notes, no transcripts, no messages, no keys.
mobile.diktatTestHinweis: Say a few sentences. The text appears while you speak; nothing is saved.
mobile.freigegeben: Allowed: the text can be inserted
mobile.instanzLaedtModell: Your covey instance is fetching the model: {{pct}} %
mobile.keinCovey: Something answers there, but it is not a covey.
mobile.keinCoveyCode: This is not a covey pairing code.
mobile.keinSprachmodell: The covey instance is still fetching the speech model. Try again in a few minutes.
mobile.keineKamera: No camera is available on this device. Open the code with “Open in the app” in the web interface instead, or connect with an address and an API key.
mobile.keineSprache: Speech recognition on the device is not available here.
mobile.koppelnFehler: This code is invalid, already used or expired. Create a new one in the web interface.
mobile.koppelnFrageText: The app will connect to this covey installation and act with your seat there. Pair only if you created the code yourself.
mobile.manuell: Connect with an address and an API key instead
mobile.meetingHinweis: Speech is recognised on this device. No audio is stored or sent.
mobile.mikrofonVerweigert: The app needs access to the microphone. You can allow it in the device's settings.
mobile.modellWahlHinweis: Larger models recognise more accurately, but need more storage and respond more slowly on the phone.
mobile.modell_medium: Most accurate, slow on the phone
mobile.modell_parakeet: Recognises 25 European languages by itself, with punctuation; in testing
mobile.modell_small: More accurate, needs more time and storage
mobile.nichtFreigegeben: Not allowed: the text cannot be inserted
mobile.nichtGeweckt: Written down. Nobody was waiting for it — the agent reads it on its next run.
mobile.nichtsErkannt: Nothing was recognised. Nothing was saved.
mobile.notizHinweis: What do you want to keep?
mobile.notizenLeer: No notes yet. Capture whatever comes to mind — typed or spoken. Your notes are private.
mobile.nurNotizen: Colleagues and conversations are not switched on in this organisation.
mobile.scanHinweis: Open covey in the browser, go to Profile & Settings → Mobile app → “Pair the mobile app”, and point the camera at the code.
mobile.schluesselAbgelehnt: The installation did not accept this key.
mobile.schluesselHinweis: Create a key in the web interface under Profile & Settings. The key is an interim: it will be replaced by a sign-in bound to this device.
mobile.sprachHinweis: Speech is recognised on this device, with a model from your covey instance. No audio leaves the phone.
mobile.spracheAus: Speech recognition is switched off on this covey instance.
mobile.teamAusKurz: Writing is not switched on yet
mobile.ueberallHinweis: Hold: speak, release: insert. Tap: hands-free, tap again: insert. The audio stays on the Mac; for the cleanup only the text goes to your covey instance, with the name of the app it is for.
mobile.ueberallSchalter: Dictate into any app with ⌥ Space
mobile.verbindenLead: The address of your covey installation, and an API key to sign in with.
mobile.waehlen: Choose a colleague on the left to open the conversation.
team.leerText: Write what needs doing below — it becomes a task.
team.wartetLead: {{count}} points are waiting for a decision.
team.wartetLead_one: One point is waiting for a decision.
team.wartetNichts: Nothing is waiting. The workforce is working or asleep.
